fields.name: api_token
fields.help: creativehub API token (Settings > API access at https://sell.creativehub.io/settings; API access must be enabled on the account, otherwise 403). Shown once at creation; sent as Authorization: Bearer <token>.

me.note: No account endpoint; the probe lists one drop (GET /v1/drops?limit=1 -> {drops[{id, title, status, slug, created_at}], limit, offset}). 401 invalid/revoked token, 403 API access disabled.

list_products.note: GET /v1/products?limit&offset: YOUR creativehub catalogue (products you created from your artwork), newest first, max 200 per page: {id, name, description, artwork_url, artwork_preview_medium_url, artwork_thumbnail_url, shopify_handle, variant_count, created_at, updated_at}. There is no keyword or category filter (query/category are ignored); prices are per variant (get_product).

get_product.note: GET /v1/products/{product_id}: the product with variants[{id, sku, size, print_width_mm, print_height_mm, is_framed, frame_color, paper_id, retail_price, price_currency, delivery_price_uk, delivery_price_eu_na, delivery_price_row, edition_size}]. price/currency/sku are the FIRST variant's; every variant is in raw.variants, and quote_shipping/create_order take a variant id. 404 if the product does not exist or is not yours.

quote_shipping.note: POST /v1/orders/quote {items[{variant_id, quantity 1-50}], delivery_country_code (ISO-2)}: one priced option {currency, total_incl_vat, total_excl_vat, total_vat, production_cost, delivery_cost, addon_cost, ddp_total} (what your account will be billed). `product_id` is a VARIANT id from get_product. 409 delivery_zone_unavailable when the destination needs a manual quote.

create_order.note: POST /v1/orders: `items` is sent as given, [{variant_id, quantity}] (up to 20 lines); shipping_address {name, address1, address2, city, postcode, state (county), country_code (ISO-2), email, phone} becomes delivery_name/_line1/_line2/_city/_postcode/_county/_country_code/_email/_phone. Returns 201 {order_id, order_number, currency, total_incl_vat, lines}; billed to your account's saved card on the next merchant rollup. 409 delivery_zone_unavailable: nothing placed.

get_order.note: GET /v1/orders/{order_id} (the order_id from create_order): order_number, status, date_due, totals, delivery summary and items[] with per-item production status (all in raw). The docs do not name the order-id or totals fields of this response, so `id` is left empty and total/currency are not mapped; read raw.

not_offered.track: Not documented: 'Each API token can carry a webhook_uri ... intended for order-status events. Not yet active ... until then poll your store platform for order state, or GET /v1/orders/{order_id}' (get_order); no tracking endpoint exists.
